name: Voxel Visualization Ray Casting
definition: A technique to visualize the voxel grid by casting rays from the camera through the unit cube, using pre-computed front and back intersection textures to determine ray origin and direction.
summary: Voxel Visualization Ray Casting is a fragment shader technique that renders 3D voxel grids in a single draw call by using pre-computed intersection textures to initialize rays, avoiding per-object draw calls.
